# Link

**Figma:** Color/Content/Hyperlink (Default · Pressed · Visited) + Focus/Accent; code-first, no Figma component set  
**Import:** `import { Link } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Navigates to another page, section or site from inside text or next to it. It uses the Content/Hyperlink colours and takes the font of the text around it; actions on the page are Buttons.

## Use it for
- Links inside running text: help copy, descriptions, empty states, inline messages.
- Standalone links to a related page (“View all invoices”, a footer link).
- Other sites (docs, status page) in a new tab with external.
- Client-side routes through your router's link: as={RouterLink} to="/x".

## Use something else for
- An action on this page (save, open a dialog, delete) → Button (level="tertiary" or appearance="flat").
- A whole row or tile that opens something → ListItem href or a clickable Card.
- Moving between app sections → Sidebar, Tabs or Bottom Navigation.
- The path of parent pages → Breadcrumbs.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Color/Content/Hyperlink | `tone` | hyperlink (default: Default, Pressed while pressed) · inherit (the surrounding text colour; underlined by default) |
| Visited | `visited` | opt-in Hyperlink/Visited after the destination was visited (search results, docs) |
| Underline | `underline` | hover (default; also on keyboard focus) · always (running text, inherit tone) · none (only where the context says it is a link) |
| External | `external` | target="_blank" + rel="noopener noreferrer" + icon-link-external-line + a hidden “(opens in a new tab)” |
| Router link | `as (+ the router's props)` | as={RouterLink} to="/x": every other prop and the ref are forwarded |
| Button look | `as="button"` | renders a <button> without browser chrome (no fill, border, padding or margin; font, spacing and alignment inherited), so it looks exactly like the anchor link |
| Typography | `— (inherited)` | put it inside Text or a line of copy; Link sets no font of its own |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/link.json`.

### Link
An inline link in the Content/Hyperlink colours (Default · Pressed · Visited). It inherits the font of the text around it, so place it inside a `<Text>` or any line of copy. Links navigate; actions on the page are Buttons. `<Text>`Invoices are in <Link href="/settings/billing">Billing settings`</Link>`.`</Text>` <Link href="https://status.zen.design" external>Status page`</Link>` <Link as={RouterLink} to="/projects">All projects`</Link>`

Also accepts `Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, "color">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | — | Destination URL. Required unless `as` renders a router link that takes its own destination prop (e.g. `to`). |
| `external` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens the destination in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing external-link icon and a visually hidden “(opens in a new tab)” (in the locale's language), so the change of context is visible and announced. Use it for other sites (docs, status pages, help centres), not for pages of the same app. |
| `underline` | `"hover" \| "always" \| "none"` | `tone === "inherit" ? "always" : "hover"` | When the underline shows: `hover` (default; also on keyboard focus) for standalone links, `always` for links inside running text so they never rely on colour alone, `none` only where the context already says it is a link (a navigation list). Defaults to `always` when `tone="inherit"`. |
| `tone` | `"hyperlink" \| "inherit"` | `"hyperlink"` | Colour: `hyperlink` (default) uses Content/Hyperlink Default, Pressed while pressed and Visited (see `visited`); `inherit` takes the surrounding text colour (footers, captions, legal lines) and is underlined by default. |
| `visited` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the Content/Hyperlink/Visited colour once the destination has been visited. Default false: in-app links keep one colour; turn it on for content links people scan repeatedly (search results, articles, docs). `hyperlink` tone only. |
| `as` | `ElementType` | `"a"` | Element or router component rendered instead of `<a>`, e.g. `as={RouterLink} to="/settings"` (React Router, Next.js Link). Every other prop, the ref included, is forwarded to it. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The link text. Name the destination (“Billing settings”), never “click here”. The font comes from the surrounding Text. |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move to the next / previous link |
| Enter | Follow the link (external: in a new tab) |

## ✅ Do
- Write link text that names the destination and makes sense on its own (“Billing settings”, “Status page”) (harness: link/vague-text).
- Underline links inside running text with underline="always", so they never rely on colour alone.
- Open other sites with external: it adds the icon, the hidden “(opens in a new tab)” and rel="noopener noreferrer" (harness: link/new-tab-is-external).
- Render client-side routes with as={RouterLink}; the router's own props (to, replace) are forwarded.
- Place a Link inside a Text or a line of copy: it takes that text style and size.
- Keep tone="inherit" links underlined (the default for inherit) in legal lines, captions and footers (harness: link/inherit-needs-underline).
- Turn on visited only for content people scan repeatedly, such as search results and docs.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a Link for an action on the page (open a dialog, delete, save); that is a Button (harness: link/needs-href).
- Don't write “click here”, “here”, “read more” or “learn more” as the whole link text (harness: link/vague-text).
- Don't open a new tab with a bare target="_blank", and don't open pages of the same app in a new tab (harness: link/new-tab-is-external).
- Don't remove the underline (underline="none") where nothing else says it is a link, such as inside a paragraph.
- Don't put a Link inside a clickable row, card or button: nested interactive elements can't be reached reliably.

## Accessibility
- Renders a native <a href> (or your router's link): Enter follows it, and it is announced and listed as a link.
- Keyboard focus shows the 3px Focus/Accent ring, plus the underline for underline="hover".
- external adds a visually hidden “(opens in a new tab)” to the name; the icon is decorative.
- Inside text, colour alone must not mark a link (WCAG 1.4.1): underline it.
- Inline links in a sentence are exempt from the 24×24 target size (WCAG 2.5.8); standalone links need room around them.

## Content
- Name the destination in sentence case; no punctuation inside the link.
- Front-load the key words (“Pricing plans”, not “Click to see our pricing plans”).
- Don't type “(opens in a new tab)” yourself: external adds it.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `link/needs-href` | error | A Link goes somewhere: give it href, or a router link through `as` (+ `to`). An action on the page is a Button. | `zen-allow-link-href: <reason>` |
| `link/vague-text` | warn | Link text names the destination on its own (“Billing settings”), never “click here”, “here”, “read more” or “learn more”. | `zen-allow-vague-link: <reason>` |
| `link/new-tab-is-external` | warn | A link that opens a new tab uses `external` (icon + hidden “(opens in a new tab)” + rel), not a bare target="_blank". | `zen-allow-new-tab: <reason>` |
| `link/inherit-needs-underline` | warn | A tone="inherit" link keeps its default underline (always): in the text's own colour the underline is the only cue. | `zen-allow-link-underline: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
